operations.text: A paid readiness pass no longer starts on an own pass nobody wrote down (RGATE-001). /pnp:review gains Step 2c, the consequence scan - one scan-tier agent per ticket searches the tree for surfaces that can violate each decision of the plan, and the COO closes every row in a file before the pass - and Step 2d, the COO's own pass as a file: the last act over the plan, one row per audited ticket against the six readiness checks, every instrument run on valid and on broken input, stamped with the plan's SHA-256 (scripts/engine/plan-gate.js --hash). The readiness brief names the plan, the audited tickets and both files on five fixed lines, and a plan-class pass does not start without them: the Codex review wrapper refuses the run (exit 2) by its class flag or by the brief's `Class: plan` line, and Gate 2 denies a Claude reviewer dispatch whose brief carries that line. It proves presence and shape, not quality. YOUR ORCHESTRATOR RULES: the first operation re-renders `.claude/aiwf-native/ORCHESTRATOR.md`, where the section Behavior ledger duty now carries the consequence scan and the own pass as the same duty, with the gate's honest limit; if you edited that file, the update asks you, and an artifact you hold through an override is not applied - the new render is recorded as upstream. SUPERSEDED LOCAL RULES: a local rule or hook that refuses a plan pass without these artifacts can become a one-line pointer to Step 2d.
